title: File:Solar eclipse skimming the horizon.jpg
desc: A partial solar eclipse during sunset.  The eclipse happened on 12 August 2026.  Here it was photographed in Malta, from Cirkewwa at the exteme NW of the island.  The cliffs to the right of the photo are Sanap Cliffs in the neighbouring island of Gozo, around 10km away.

desc:

title: File:Edward S. Curtis Collection — The wokas season--Klamath.jpg
desc:
The wókas season--Klamath.
The staple article of food was the seed of the yellow water-lily, Nymphæa polysepala. It is used as a delicacy. The extensive marshes of the region are in many places covered solidly to the extent of hundreds and thousands of acres with the spreading leaves of this plants.
